about: Judge unit cases: reviewer blockers copied verbatim from the accepted replies (telemetry 'reply') of labeled round-1 records, each judged alone as a debate judges it (evidence check and claim-quote linkage, then the hedge check) against its fixture's diff and index. 'expected' is where the blocker ends under judge j8-claim-quote-linkage: kept, quote (evidence check), link (linkage) or hedge. 'label' and 'valid' come from eval_harness/corpus_labels.json or labels.json. Cases marked 'known limit' or 'known cost' pin what the judge gets wrong today; a judge change that fixes one updates 'expected' here with its JUDGE_VERSION, never silently. 'bridge' is docs/fixtures/qttune_bridge_refactor.diff with the committed repo_context.json; other fixtures are corpus ids (docs/fixtures/corpus.json).

label: decode_length_8
cases.why: a defect on one post-change line, quoted from it

blocker.claim: In handleFrameInternal, the code assumes a fixed 8-byte CAN payload length when calling qttune_decode_signal, which is incorrect for CAN-FD frames that can have payloads longer than 8 bytes.

label: backoff_overshoot
cases.why: a wrong condition, quoted from the added line

blocker.claim: The inlined backoff calculation has an incorrect condition that allows backoff_ms to exceed J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS before being clamped, changing the timing behavior from the original j2534_backoff_next function

label: invariant-elsewhere
cases.why: known limit: a quote proves the line exists, not that the claim holds; parse_query enforces the channel elsewhere

blocker.claim: Hardcoded channel 0 in build_mode01_request breaks C ABI channel selection - the core module must not assume channel 0 exists or is appropriate for all PIDs

label: thread-confusion
cases.why: known limit: a race claimed on state only the GUI thread touches

blocker.claim: Thread-unsafe access to m_supportGeneration array without synchronization

label: count_under_error
cases.why: known cost: a removal-caused bug quoted from the removed line

blocker.claim: Removing the trusted count validation breaks the safety guard against vendor bugs that leave pNumMsgs untouched on error
blocker.quote:
long rc = handle->read_msgs(channel, &msg, &num, timeout_ms);
    num = qttune_trusted_count(rc, num);

label: other-fp
cases.why: a removed comment quoted as current code

blocker.claim: connectCoreOnly now starts the session internally, but the comment claims 'safe on ANY thread' - starting a session is not thread-safe without the GUI thread's state being ready
blocker.quote: *// Pure-core half: safe on ANY thread. Creates, registers, starts. On

label: invariant-elsewhere
cases.why: the claim names chan_count, which its quote's hunk does not contain

blocker.claim: Worker unconditionally accesses t->chans[0] for poll requests without verifying chan_count > 0. This is undefined behavior if chan_count is 0.

label: start_before_gui_owns
cases.why: known cost: onFrame lives in another hunk than the quoted lambda

blocker.claim: Use-after-free potential in onFrame callback: session started before GUI thread ownership transfer allows frames to arrive and call onFrame while bridge may be destroyed

label: start_before_gui_owns
cases.why: by design: a hedged claim is a question even when true

blocker.claim: Potential use-after-free: lambda captures session by value but the destructor may run before the queued lambda executes, and there's no mechanism to cancel the queued call
Race condition: m_supportGeneration written in applyConnectedState while potentially read concurrently by pollChannelSupport

label: race
cases.why: the data race, quoted from post-change code

blocker.claim: Thread safety violation: m_currentFrameCount is accessed from worker thread without atomic protection

label: gate
cases.why: the removed in-flight bound, quoted from the cumulative check that replaced it

blocker.claim: Backpressure logic is broken: the check against m_currentFrameCount does not prevent queuing - there is no atomic increment before invokeMethod to reserve the slot

label: deletion
cases.why: the deletion class: code the diff removes, quoted as current

blocker.claim: Thread safety violation: SignalListModel::updateValues() modifies shared state without synchronization from arbitrary caller thread
